name: prep
note: Differential test for 3D5E. All three original instances have the same shape — dialogue, then 3D5E, then 3D32 to a new world-map location, then a BGM change, then a route marker — so the command may only matter as preparation for the 3D32 that follows it. worldmap-1 ran it standalone and saw nothing. Here the same 3D32 jump is performed twice, once plain and once preceded by 3D5E, so any difference in the following command's duration or picture is attributable to 3D5E. Everything runs in the opening before 3D4D, which is the only context where the world-map overlay is loaded.

commands.note: control: the jump WITHOUT 3D5E, using the location from the original site
the original order: 3D5E immediately before the jump
the same jump, now preceded by 3D5E — any difference is 3D5E's doing
the BGM change that follows in all three original sites
